TFIDF_local.implementation: new cached adapter of existing generic formula; toy-only conformance check

parameter_basis: upstream default constructors, not tuned on queries; no claim these equal Elasticsearch defaults
tokenizer: [a-z_][a-z0-9_]* lowercase, no stopwords/stemming/query expansion; query multiplicity retained
corpus: same frozen48 complete-document lowRISC chunks; chunk text only, same for all
queries: same20 adopted raw prompts; no ref/TB/outcome use
selection: eligible iff shared token with query; sort full score descending then ID ascending; up to3; no numeric score threshold; empty if no lexical match
selection_reason: uniform nonmatch exclusion because BM25L/Plus include nonzero baseline terms; not calibrated using benchmark results
context: same frozen template and fragment format; complete chosen chunks; no adaptive token clipping
execution: single pass20queries x4methods=80; eachmethod/query exactlyonce; no rerun/tuning; no generation/embedding/EDA/network in runner
metrics: full rankings/rawscores retained but scores not compared across algorithms
index build time and single-pass warm query time separately
limits: 20 queries,48 docs,4 methods,top3; max process120s; local outputs only; no package installation
